notes.title: We are Coming!!!!
notes.content:
Greeting everyone!!
After a month of testing,We have finally completed the official version of the development work.So We decide finish Early Access And push to Full Version.
And change the price to 14.99(USD)
Each Player Who buy this game before,Please send your nickname to My Email or Add me.I will save you name,and in a few months later.You will get a key free for our next game.
Email ad : typewingzero@qq.com

notes.title: Update(v.0.9.1.12)Finish
notes.content:
Greeting!Everyone!
Finally,We push the verson to the 0.9.And in the verson,We're prepared some fun for you.
1.We Reworked hero skills,It won't like put a card,The spell will appear in your hand.you will like it.
2.When you in battle.you can replace your unit.It's will be funny.
3.We fix some stupid bugs:
1).crash in Survival mode
2).Changed the view and default points in the survival mode
3).Modify some of the statements in the tutorial
4).Modified an arrow in the tutorial will not move
5).After the PVP, Your the position will be very high when you go to other battle(We fix that)
So.I hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Update(v.7.2.12.12)
notes.content:
After a week, we get a lot of valuable advice according to the player's feedback, we have a number of adjustments to the game engine to improve the image resolution. At the same time found a number of BUG server, and found a number of reasons for the game crash.
This update will take nearly an hour, in this period of time, the game will not be able to log in
After we will continue to receive comments from the players, the players are welcome to tell us what you think
Thank you and hope you enjoy

notes.title: Game Update(V.0.7.1.12.9)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone.The server has been restart.
Update List;
1.In the room, when the line is encountered in the hand of the card will appear a soldier of the information panel, to facilitate the players to understand the information and do not have to take a card like before。
2.The hint of a spell is more obvious in the tutorial (an arrow on the back of the hand).
3.About Special attack(The Card behind your tower).Added a special effect, so it looks more obvious
4.Modified on the matching process, and now can be free to challenge the players, and do not need to match the two players at the same time
5.Fix the Bug of STAGE 1...........again......(I very very very very hate this bug.If anyone happen again,Please let me know)
6.Online personnel management
7.Fix some English tips
Hope enjoy it and have a good weekend.
